title: OLD WINESKINS – YOU CAN’T FIT GOD’S NEW WORK INTO YOUR OLD LIFE! 🔥
paragraphs:
OLD WINESKINS – YOU CAN’T FIT GOD’S NEW WORK INTO YOUR OLD LIFE! 🔥
📖 Luke 5:37-38 – "And no one pours new wine into old wineskins. Otherwise, the new wine will burst the skins; the wine will run out and the wineskins will be ruined. No, new wine must be poured into new wineskins."

❓ READER QUESTION:
"Brother John, what did Jesus mean when He talked about new wine and old wineskins? How does this apply to my walk with Christ?"
🔥 EXCELLENT QUESTION! Many people try to fit their new life in Christ into their old habits, traditions, and mindset. But Jesus made it clear—THE OLD AND THE NEW CANNOT MIX!
🚨 If you are holding on to the past, you are resisting what God wants to do in your life!
⚠️ WARNING: If you try to put new wine into old wineskins, YOU WILL BURST!

🔥 1. WHAT IS THE PARABLE OF THE NEW WINE IN OLD WINESKINS?
📖 Mark 2:22 – "And no one pours new wine into old wineskins. Otherwise, the wine will burst the skins, and both the wine and the wineskins will be ruined. No, they pour new wine into new wineskins."
🔥 JESUS IS TEACHING:

✔️ The "new wine" represents His new covenant, new life, and new work.
✔️ The "old wineskins" represent old religious traditions, old mindsets, and the old sinful life.
✔️ If you try to mix the new with the old, it will destroy BOTH!
💡 JESUS DID NOT COME TO PATCH UP THE OLD SYSTEM—HE CAME TO BRING A COMPLETELY NEW LIFE!
🚨 Are you still trying to mix your past life with your new faith in Christ?

🔥 2. WHY CAN’T THE OLD AND NEW MIX?
📖 2 Corinthians 5:17 – "Therefore, if anyone is in Christ, he is a new creation. The old has passed away; behold, the new has come."
🔥 WHAT DOES THIS MEAN?

❌ You can’t mix GRACE with LEGALISM. (Galatians 2:16)
❌ You can’t mix FAITH with DEAD RELIGION. (James 2:26)
❌ You can’t mix HOLINESS with a SINFUL LIFESTYLE. (1 Peter 1:16)
❌ You can’t mix GOD’S PLAN with YOUR OWN DESIRES. (Luke 9:23)
🚨 If you try to live a "half-Christian" life, you will end up BURSTING—completely unstable, confused, and spiritually lost!
💡 ARE YOU STILL TRYING TO LIVE WITH ONE FOOT IN THE WORLD AND ONE FOOT IN GOD’S KINGDOM?

🔥 3. WHY DID JESUS USE WINESKINS AS AN EXAMPLE?
📖 Matthew 9:17 – "Neither do people pour new wine into old wineskins. If they do, the skins will burst; the wine will run out and the wineskins will be ruined."
🔥 WHAT HAPPENS WHEN YOU POUR NEW WINE INTO OLD WINESKINS?

✔️ Old wineskins are stiff and can’t expand. (Like religious people stuck in tradition!)
✔️ New wine expands as it ferments. (Like the Holy Spirit transforming a believer!)
✔️ If you put new wine in an old wineskin, it will BURST! (Just like how religious leaders rejected Jesus!)
🚨 THIS IS WHY JESUS CLASHED WITH THE PHARISEES!

❌ They wanted to keep their old religious system. (Matthew 23:13-15)
❌ They rejected the new life Jesus was bringing. (John 5:39-40)
❌ They couldn’t accept that salvation was through faith, not works. (Ephesians 2:8-9)
💡 HAVE YOU TRULY EMBRACED THE NEW LIFE IN CHRIST, OR ARE YOU STILL CLINGING TO OLD RELIGIOUS HABITS?

🔥 4. HOW TO BECOME A "NEW WINESKIN" FOR GOD?
📖 Ezekiel 36:26 – "I will give you a new heart and put a new spirit in you; I will remove from you your heart of stone and give you a heart of flesh."
🔥 STEPS TO BECOMING A NEW WINESKIN:

✔️ SURRENDER FULLY TO JESUS – Let Him make you new! (Romans 12:1-2)
✔️ BREAK FREE FROM RELIGIOUS LEGALISM – It’s about relationship, not rituals! (Galatians 5:1)
✔️ LET GO OF YOUR OLD LIFE – True repentance means complete transformation! (Luke 5:32)
✔️ ALLOW THE HOLY SPIRIT TO EXPAND YOU – Be flexible to God’s new work! (John 3:8)
🚨 IF YOU REFUSE TO CHANGE, YOU WILL MISS WHAT GOD IS DOING!
💡 ARE YOU WILLING TO BECOME A NEW WINESKIN FOR CHRIST?

🔥 FINAL WARNING: YOU MUST CHOOSE – OLD LIFE OR NEW LIFE?
📖 Hebrews 10:39 – "But we do not belong to those who shrink back and are destroyed, but to those who have faith and are saved."

🔥 WHAT WILL YOU CHOOSE?
❌ Stay stuck in old traditions, dead religion, and a weak faith?
✔️ Step into the NEW, transforming work of Jesus Christ?
🚨 JESUS WILL NOT POUR NEW WINE INTO OLD WINESKINS—YOU MUST BECOME NEW!
💡 Will you allow Jesus to fully transform you today?

🙏 PRAYER TO BECOME A NEW WINESKIN FOR GOD!
"Lord Jesus, I don’t want to mix my old ways with Your new work. Transform my heart, renew my mind, and make me a new creation. Fill me with Your Spirit and help me to fully embrace the new life You have for me. I surrender completely to You. In Jesus’ name, AMEN!"
